headline: Full-stack engineer building React Native products, realtime systems, and web platforms.
about: I ship production software across mobile and web. Since graduating from Gujarat Technological University in 2023, I have spent 3+ years building React Native apps and 1.5+ years delivering React, Next.js, Angular, and .NET platforms. Recent work includes a Play Store fintech product, a Kafka-backed ride-sharing system with Stripe payments, and marketplace, travel, and operations tools. I care about clean architecture, realtime UX, and software that holds up after launch.

bullets: Delivered 15+ production applications spanning React Native, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, and .NET.
Built and shipped consumer mobile products with Play Store releases, monorepo shared packages, and Instagram-style product UX.
Designed realtime backends using Node.js, Kafka event streams, and Stripe payments for live tracking and booking flows.
Implemented business dashboards and e-commerce systems with React, Kendo UI, Angular, .NET, and SQL Server reporting.
Worked across the stack from UI architecture and API design to database modeling, Git-based delivery, and CI/CD.
